title: 特别的排列
summary: 统计数组的排列数，使每对相邻元素中一个能整除另一个，答案取模。
insight: 用位掩码记录已使用下标，并记录排列末尾下标。只有新元素与末尾满足任一方向整除时才能追加；相同 mask、last 的剩余方案完全相同，可记忆化。
pitfalls: 两个整除方向满足任一即可
状态按下标而不是数值
单元素数组有一个排列

solutions.title: 末尾下标状态压缩 DP
solutions.idea: 枚举每个起点并记忆后续合法追加数。
steps: 若 mask 已包含全部元素返回一
若 nums[last] 与 nums[next] 可整除，递归新状态
对每个起点 dfs(1<<start,start) 求和取模

code.java: class Solution { private static final int MOD=1000000007;private int[] nums;private int[][] memo;private int full;private int dfs(int mask,int last){if(mask==full)return 1;if(memo[mask][last]!=-1)return memo[mask][last];long ways=0;for(int next=0;next<nums.length;next++)if((mask&(1<<next))==0&&(nums[last]%nums[next]==0||nums[next]%nums[last]==0))ways=(ways+dfs(mask|1<<next,next))%MOD;return memo[mask][last]=(int)ways;}public int specialPerm(int[] nums){this.nums=nums;full=(1<<nums.length)-1;memo=new int[1<<nums.length][nums.length];for(int[] row:memo)Arrays.fill(row,-1);long answer=0;for(int start=0;start<nums.length;start++)answer=(answer+dfs(1<<start,start))%MOD;return (int)answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private val mod=1000000007;private lateinit var nums:IntArray;private lateinit var memo:Array<IntArray>;private var full=0;private fun dfs(mask:Int,last:Int):Int{if(mask==full)return 1;if(memo[mask][last]!=-1)return memo[mask][last];var ways=0L;for(next in nums.indices)if((mask and (1 shl next))==0&&(nums[last]%nums[next]==0||nums[next]%nums[last]==0))ways=(ways+dfs(mask or (1 shl next),next))%mod;memo[mask][last]=ways.toInt();return ways.toInt()};fun specialPerm(nums:IntArray):Int{this.nums=nums;full=(1 shl nums.size)-1;memo=Array(1 shl nums.size){IntArray(nums.size){-1}};var answer=0L;for(start in nums.indices)answer=(answer+dfs(1 shl start,start))%mod;return answer.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { static constexpr int MOD=1000000007;vector<int> nums;vector<vector<int>> memo;int full;int dfs(int mask,int last){if(mask==full)return 1;if(memo[mask][last]!=-1)return memo[mask][last];long long ways=0;for(int next=0;next<(int)nums.size();++next)if(!(mask&(1<<next))&&(nums[last]%nums[next]==0||nums[next]%nums[last]==0))ways=(ways+dfs(mask|1<<next,next))%MOD;return memo[mask][last]=ways;}public:int specialPerm(vector<int>& input){nums=input;full=(1<<nums.size())-1;memo.assign(1<<nums.size(),vector<int>(nums.size(),-1));long long answer=0;for(int start=0;start<(int)nums.size();++start)answer=(answer+dfs(1<<start,start))%MOD;return answer;} };
